appDescription: RideMate helps a parent pick up a child from an after-school academy by recommending the departure time, pickup spot and waiting place, and by guiding the trip with the vehicle navigation.

function.name: GET_PICKUP_STATUS
function.description: Gets today's child pickup status, including the academy end time, recommended departure time, remaining time and pickup spot.

function.name: SEND_PICKUP_MESSAGE
function.description: Sends the child a text message with the pickup spot link, or reminds the child that the car has arrived at the pickup spot.

messageType.description: PICKUP_SPOT sends the pickup spot link. ARRIVED reminds the child that the car is waiting at the pickup spot.

function.name: START_PICKUP
function.description: Starts today's child pickup in RideMate, or moves the ongoing pickup trip to its next step with vehicle navigation.

step.description: TODAY starts today's pickup. PICKUP_SPOT drives to the pickup spot. WAITING_PLACE drives to a waiting place near the pickup spot. HOME drives home after the child gets in the car.
